span.p:
Locks and protocol data are kept
until rollback finishes, so nobody
reads half-undone data.
Later requests get TxAbortedError.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Committed and Aborted are final.
Commit on an aborted tx is rejected.
